Assert that columns have no missing values

Source: R/ensure_complete.R
ensure_complete.Rd

A checkpoint for the columns an analysis cannot do without: an id, a date, the outcome. A missing value in them drops the row from a model without a word, or makes it a group of its own in a count. Returns data, so it can sit in the middle of a pipeline.

Usage

ensure_complete(
  data,
  ...,
  success_msg = NULL,
  warn_msg = NULL,
  abort_msg = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame or tibble, a database table (dbplyr, e.g. DuckDB) or an Arrow table or dataset; see Database and Arrow tables.

...

Columns that must be complete (tidy-select). If omitted, all columns are checked.

success_msg

Message shown when the rule holds. If NULL (default), it is "Check passed: <message>" when warn_msg or abort_msg is given, so the console names every check that ran, and a description of the check otherwise.

warn_msg

Message shown when values are missing and no abort_msg is set. Defaults to a description naming the columns.

abort_msg

If provided, cli::cli_abort() is called with this message when the rule is broken. If NULL (default), a warning is issued instead.

Value

data invisibly, unchanged.

Details

On failure the rows with a missing value in any of the columns are reported, with a missing column prepended that names the columns missing in that row, e.g. "born, sex". The summary counts the rows and the different combinations of missing columns.

Missing means NA, and for numbers NaN too, as in is.na(); an empty string is a value. In a database table missing means NULL.

See also

describe_varying() and describe_key(), which count missing values per column, ensure_valid_spells() for missing spell bounds, checkpoints.

Examples

persons <- data.frame(
  cpr  = c("a", "b", NA, "d"),
  born = as.Date(c("1980-05-01", NA, NA, "1975-02-11")),
  sex  = c("F", "M", "F", NA)
)

# Success: no one lacks a sex among the first three
ensure_complete(persons[1:3, ], sex)
#> ✔ Complete: sex

# Warning: b lacks a birth date, the third row a cpr as well
ensure_complete(persons, cpr, born)
#> Warning: Missing values in: cpr, born
#> ℹ 2 rows in 2 groups
#>   Missing per column: born (2), cpr (1)
#> ℹ The rows:
#>     missing   cpr   born   sex
#>     <chr>     <chr> <date> <chr>
#>   1 born      b     NA     M
#>   2 cpr, born NA    NA     F

# All columns
ensure_complete(persons)
#> Warning: Missing values in: all columns
#> ℹ 3 rows in 3 groups
#>   Missing per column: born (2), cpr (1), sex (1)
#> ℹ The rows:
#>     missing   cpr   born       sex
#>     <chr>     <chr> <date>     <chr>
#>   1 born      b     NA         M
#>   2 cpr, born NA    NA         F
#>   3 sex       d     1975-02-11 NA
